rulings.challenge_claim: The row's own quote for the verse's second colon (bare מעקש דרכיו) silently drops the vav-conjunctive prefix carried by the actual pointed word.
rulings.grounds: Byte tier oshb:Prov.10.9 reads "הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בַּ֭תֹּם יֵ֣לֶךְ בֶּ֑טַח וּמְעַקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו יִוָּדֵֽעַ"; consonantal_index.json skeleton is "הולך בתם ילך בטח ומעקש דרכיו יודע" -- the second-colon word is vav-prefixed, not bare as the row's observed_substrate_signals quotes it against the same cited ref. Unpointed, tier-undisclosed quote; confirmed defect at both byte and skeleton tier. Boundary call unaffected: word-bound skeleton comparison of Prov.10.8|10.9 and Prov.10.9|10.10 (against "חֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקַּ֣ח מִצְוֺ֑ת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט" and "קֹ֣רֵֽץ עַ֭יִן יִתֵּ֣ן עַצָּ֑בֶת וֶאֱוִ֥יל שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יִלָּבֵֽט") shows zero shared content tokens on both sides, so the single_proverb verdict stands.
rulings.remedy: Replace the observed_substrate_signals quote with the byte- or skeleton-spliced form (vav retained), spliced programmatically from verse_map_oshb.json/consonantal_index.json -- never hand-retyped -- and disclose the tier used. Cure passes when a fresh collate.py --ref oshb:Prov.10.9 --quote check on the revised phrase clears byte or skeleton grade rather than a masked substring match.

rulings.challenge_claim: device_notes states both cola of the 10:16-17 cluster lack an adversative "but," but WEB's own rendering of Prov.10.17 contains "but."
rulings.grounds: verse_map_web.json clean text for Prov.10.17: "He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray." -- contains "but", directly contradicting the device_notes parenthetical. The underlying MT vav (oshb:Prov.10.17 "אֹ֣רַח לְ֭חַיִּים שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מוּסָ֑ר וְעוֹזֵ֖ב תּוֹכַ֣חַת מַתְעֶֽה") is a plain conjunctive/disjunctive vav with no distinct adversative marker, so neither witness supports an unqualified 'no adversative' claim either way. The cluster's underlying catchword-rarity claim is independently re-confirmed here: word-bound skeleton sweep of the prefixed noun against consonantal_index.json returns exactly 4 verses book-wide (Prov.10.16, Prov.10.17, Prov.11.19, Prov.19.23), with 10:16-10:17 the only adjacent pair -- matching both primaries' independent re-sweeps and unaffected by this defect. LF and OL raised the identical defect independently from the identical bytes -- one defect, not two.
rulings.remedy: Drop or rewrite the device_notes parenthetical; state accurately that WEB's translation of 10:17 supplies an adversative 'but' while the MT vav itself is unmarked/ambiguous. Cure passes when device_notes no longer asserts a claim contradicted by an already-cited witness.

rulings.challenge_claim: rejected_alternative's absolute claim that the verse "finds no lexical echo in either neighbor's own imagery" is contradicted by shared lev/tsadiq tokens with Prov.10.21.
rulings.grounds: Word-bound skeleton comparison (consonantal_index.json) of Prov.10.20 and Prov.10.21 shows shared tokens: לב, צדיק. Independent re-derivation (word-bound split on consonantal_index.json skeletons, NOT sweep.py --skel, which over-counts via substring contamination -- e.g. lev returns 120 and tsadiq 66 under contiguous-substring search) confirms OL's exact digits: lev = 47/915 verses, tsadiq = 34/915 verses book-wide -- both chapter-generic, far from the 4/915 catchword-grade bar set by the 10:16-17 cluster in this same span. The rejected_alternative's absolute claim is true for the Prov.10.19 side (zero shared tokens, confirmed) but false for the Prov.10.21 side. The single_proverb call itself is not threatened -- neither shared term is distinguishing -- but the unqualified 'no lexical echo... in either neighbor' wording is factually wrong and needs correction.
rulings.remedy: Rewrite rejected_alternative to scope the claim per neighbor: true zero-overlap with 10:19; with 10:21, only chapter-generic terms (lev, tsadiq) recur, both below catchword-grade frequency and not a distinguishing image, so no cluster forms. Cure passes when no unqualified absolute-negation claim remains uncontradicted by a word-bound skeleton check.

rulings.challenge_claim: rejected_alternative's claim that Prov.10.25's storm imagery "has nothing in common" with this verse is contradicted by a shared rasha token; separately, the row's own quote drops the vav-conjunctive prefix on the source word.
rulings.grounds: (a) Byte/skeleton tier: Prov.10.24 ("מְגוֹרַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע הִ֣יא תְבוֹאֶ֑נּוּ וְתַאֲוַ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן") and Prov.10.25 ("כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֭וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם") share the word-bound token rasha. Independent word-bound re-sweep against consonantal_index.json returns 36/915 verses book-wide, matching OL's digit exactly -- chapter-generic, not catchword-grade, so the single_proverb call is unaffected. This is the SAME 10:24/10:25 boundary that P05-028 also mischaracterizes from the other side using the identical token -- a seam-pair, not two independent defects. (b) Byte tier confirms the row's second quoted phrase should carry a vav prefix: skeleton "מגורת רשע היא תבואנו ותאות צדיקים יתן" shows the vav-prefixed form, while the row's observed_substrate_signals quotes the bare form against the same cited ref -- the same S-3 quote-fidelity class as P05-013/P05-021, now the third confirmed instance in this cluster, every one at the second slot of an A/B quoted-pair gloss while other prefix types (lamed, bet, kaf) are correctly retained elsewhere in the same rows. This pattern is narrow and systemic enough within c07 (3 of 8 rows) to warrant a part-wide sweep of p05's A/B quoted-pair fields for the same vav-drop, rather than spot fixes.
rulings.remedy: (a) SEAM-PAIR CURE, one edit covers both P05-027 and P05-028: rewrite both rows' rejected_alternative/rationale to disclose the shared chapter-generic rasha token without an absolute zero-overlap claim, preserving the atomic verdict on both sides. (b) Same quote-fidelity cure as P05-013/P05-021: splice the vav-prefixed form programmatically, disclose tier; recommend the author wave run a part-wide grep of p05 observed_substrate_signals fields for bare forms of vav-initial source words.
